title: Quran Hub
description: The Quran section of Islamic Archives: tafseer, the word-by-word corpus, a catalogue of early manuscripts and the scholars who study them.
intro: Tools and references for studying the Qur'an. Everything here is searchable from the search box at the top of any page, and each catalogue entry carries an archived date and a note on how to cite it.

tiles.heading: Quran Word Corpus
tiles.text: Read the Qur'an word by word, with the grammar and root of every word, a dictionary of roots, a table of verbs and a concordance.

tiles.heading: Tafseer
tiles.text: Commentaries on the Qur'an, translations with commentary and writings on interpretation, from the library.

tiles.heading: Manuscript catalogue
tiles.text: Early Qur'an manuscripts, studies of their script and dating, and the libraries and databases that hold them.

tiles.heading: Manuscript scholars
tiles.text: Scholars and research projects working on early Qur'an manuscripts: palaeography, codicology and textual variants.
